title: equisetum variegatum var. arenarium
intro: Equisetum variegatum var. arenarium, commonly known as Sand Horsetail, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Sand Horsetail include its ability to promote urinary tract health, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and caffeic acid, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
